label: Queue in memory
description: An @queue broker that keeps its queues in arrays for as long as the process lives. It grants one connection kind and no port: what may be asked of a queue is @queue's business, and this plugin only answers it. Nothing is written to disk and nothing survives a restart, which is what makes it right for development, for tests and for the trees under libraries/ -- and wrong for any message that must still be there tomorrow.
